data.long_meaning: Ansav is a name derived from Sanskrit language. It means 'Answered' or 'Resolved'. In Hindu mythology, Ansav is a name of Lord Vishnu who is known as the preserver of the universe and the savior of all beings. The name carries the spiritual message of providing solace, guidance, and solutions to the problems of life. The name Ansav carries the meaning “Answered, Resolved” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ansav usually hope their child will grow to embody answered, resolved and live with faith, good character and purpose.
